rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dropped_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dropped CobaltStrike beacon DLL in temp directory"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        maltype = "trojan"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 24 00 [1-4] 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // Common beacon config pattern
        $mutex_str = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{b1e5}" wide ascii
        $reg_persist = "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\SysUpdate" wide ascii
    condition:
        (any of ($beacon_config)) and $mutex_str and $reg_persist
}

arguments.summary: Proactive hardening initiated in response to new threat intelligence indicating a resurgence of a known threat actor. A series of previously successful containment actions were replayed across multiple systems, including host quarantine, user account disablement, IP blocking, and critical patching. The incident involved the coordinated replay of prior containment actions, including host quarantine, user account disablement, IP blocking, and critical patching.
